prompt:
Implement the missing `VcfAutomationClient.java` as a single dependency-free Java 17 source file for VCF Automation 9.1. Before implementing, research Get Projects and Get Deployments in the official Broadcom VCF Automation xAPIs reference. Confirm their methods, paths, query parameters, pagination, response schemas, status codes, and authentication requirements, and cite the official sources consulted in the final answer.

Expose this public API: `new VcfAutomationClient(URI baseUri, String bearerToken)`, `List<Deployment> listDeployments(String projectName)`, and `void emitDeployments(String projectName, PrintStream out)`, with a public nested `Deployment` record containing `id`, `name`, and `status`. Look up the project with `GET /iaas/api/projects` and `$filter=name eq '<projectName>'`, require exactly one exact-name match, and use its returned identifier when filtering deployments. Retrieve every page from `GET /deployment/api/deployments` with zero-based `page`, `size=2`, and `projects=<returned project id>`; do not stop after the first page. Return deployments in stable Java string order by `name`, then `id`. `emitDeployments` must emit one UTF-8 JSON object per line with keys in exactly `id`, `name`, `status` order and valid JSON escaping. Send `Authorization: Bearer <token>` and `Accept: application/json` on every request and surface non-2xx responses as failures. Use only the Java 17 standard library.

Change only `VcfAutomationClient.java`. Run `bash run_verify.sh`.
